title: All Spreads
blurb: To facilitate recipe discovery using the client's products, the Daymaker app arranges recipes in a circular manner, resembling a clock.

case.lede: To facilitate recipe discovery using the client's products, the Daymaker app arranges recipes in a circular manner, resembling a clock.
problem: A conventional recipe grid treats every dish as equivalent. The client's products, however, belong to moments: breakfast spreads, an afternoon snack, something to put out before dinner. A flat list flattened that meaning and left users scrolling without a reason to stop.
The brief asked for discovery, not search. People arriving at the site did not know the recipe they wanted. They knew the time of day.
case.quote: The clock became the navigation. Time of day is the only filter anyone actually uses.

approach.body: Recipes sit on a radial track. Rotating the dial moves through the day, and each position brings its cluster of dishes forward. The interaction is pointer, keyboard, and touch driven, with a plain list view underneath for anyone who does not want the dial.
bullets: Radial layout computed from a single angle value, so the whole scene animates from one source of truth.
Arrow keys step recipe to recipe; Home and End jump to the start and end of the day.
Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion by swapping the rotation for a crossfade.

case.shotsCaption: Three states of the dial, plus the list fallback

interesting.body: Every card's position, scale, and opacity derives from its angular distance to the active slot. One function, no per-card state, and the browser gets a single composited transform per node.

code.html:
// position derives from angular distance to the active slot
const place = (i, active, total) => {
  const step  = 360 / total;
  const delta = shortestArc(i * step, active * step);
  const near  = 1 - Math.min(Math.abs(delta) / 90, 1);
  return {
    transform: `rotate(${delta}deg) translateY(-42vmin)`,
    scale:      0.72 + near * 0.28,
    opacity:   0.35 + near * 0.65,
  };
};
